scope: Source-qualified background and cutoff voting for every qualified 2026 House incumbent candidate

findings_and_repairs.finding: FEC-only service qualification omitted three independently identifiable incumbents.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Use the dated Clerk snapshot plus the unique stable Bioguide service identity, with name, state, party and sworn-date guards. Recover Kiley, Harris and Menendez without arbitrarily resolving campaign FEC IDs.
findings_and_repairs.remaining_hold: Bonnie Watson Coleman's NJ-03 Write-In label remains unlinked to the NJ-12 campaign identity. Native labels are not corrected by assumption.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The historical biography parser intentionally omitted education and career sections and missed some header variants.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Add an opt-in current-incumbent parser qualified by unique official member website. Handle credentials, optional punctuation and page-interrupted section labels. Stop at offices and labelled personal sections. Do not change the frozen historical parser.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The directory itself omits some birth and career facts, and recent special-election members require supplemental records.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Acquire eleven stable-ID-qualified official Historian biographies. Every qualified incumbent now has actual birth, education and career values; attendance is not relabeled graduation.
findings_and_repairs.qualification: Undated pages retrieved after the election remain descriptive and model-ineligible.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Nickname mismatches withheld existing source observations even after the person's stable identity was qualified.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Accept the already-qualified native candidate name or an explicit reviewed same-ID, same-state official alias. Preserve all absent-ID campaign joins as held.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Questionnaire absence is not the end of the religion-source search, but unknown responses are not known affiliations.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Acquire or review six direct public self-descriptions. Retain 340 substantive observations, 16 explicit unknown/refused responses and four unresolved disclosures. Keep explicit unknowns in the missing-field audit.
findings_and_repairs.remaining_gaps: Adelita Grijalva, Analilia Mejia, Christian Menefee and James Walkinshaw. Search and rejected-proxy dispositions are in data/incumbent-disclosure-search.json.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A skipped delegate row in the veterans PDF could contaminate the previous member's military-branch field.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Terminate branch extraction at every numbered source row, including rows that cannot be qualified. Add a regression test. Omission remains unknown, not nonservice.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Current voting, prior ideology and donor scores have different vintages and support.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Export 119th-Congress cutoff-only cast votes for all 360 incumbents, with source party codes, dates and denominators. Withhold unity below 50 party-dividing votes. Preserve 118th-Congress ideology and historical donor scores as distinct selective fields.
findings_and_repairs.qualification: Kiley's current native affiliation differs from the Republican-coded source voting spell. The export does not claim that spell is every vote of the Congress.
